description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Undying Malice triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.
